name: token-escrow-after-restart

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/restart_test.go — after a restart every session's control_holder is null (escrow), a core never restores a holder from disk, and the first client of a session.join.rw principal to attach takes the token

harness/rigs/kill-core.sh — kill -9 the core with two clients attached; after the restart the first to reattach holds the control token and a view-only client already attached is sent token reason attach

description: With no clients attached the control token is held in escrow and granted on the next attach (phase-01; PTY §7.1; immortality §7). A core restart disconnects every client, so after it the token is in escrow for every session: the record's control_holder is null, and a core never restores a holder from disk (C6 carries no escrow state). The first client of a principal that may type takes it: its attached frame names it as holder, and a view-only client already attached is told with a token frame, reason attach. A session.join.ro principal never takes it.
